text:
zoe.marketing: Quick ask for runtime before keynote: we need a tiny, reproducible bench to validate two headline numbers for the launch slide (p50/p95 and tokens/sec) for 13B-quant and 70B-fp16. Also need a way to tag traces so sales can route webinar signups. Deadline: ~24h.

ali.runtime: We can do that. Do you want coldstart included? Also which quantized variant for 13B? 4-bit or 8-bit?

zoe.marketing: Go with 13B-4bit and 70B-fp16. Include both coldstart and warmed runs. Keep the sweep tiny: 100 requests per variant. Capture full traces + request headers.

pat.eng: Ill schedule on staging. Plan: warmup=10, seq_len=512, batch=auto. Will emit: latency_hist.csv, tokens_per_sec.txt, sample_traces.tar.gz, bench_map.csv. ETA ~4h.

rachel.analytics: For joins please add a stable header key we can parse: X-RWI-Route:webinar-may and ensure bench_run_id is present in every trace. We'll need a small CSV mapping bench_run_id -> header for CRM.

ali.runtime: Bench client will set the header and bench_run_id. Example run:
``` 
./tools/run_bench --model 13b-4bit --n 100 --warmup 10 --header "X-RWI-Route:webinar-may" --out /tmp/bench-1825000000
```

benchbot: Job queued: bench-1825000000 (owner: pat.eng). Est runtime: 00:20:00.

pat.eng: 13B-4bit warmed results: p50=46ms p95=230ms; coldstart p95=500ms. Throughput ~= 780 toks/sec. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-dev/launch/1825000000/13b-4bit/

pat.eng: 70B-fp16 warmed results: p50=125ms p95=460ms; coldstart p95=980ms. Throughput ~= 2050 toks/sec. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-dev/launch/1825000000/70b-fp16/

rachel.analytics: Received sample_traces and bench_map.csv. Header present and bench_run_id populated. We'll handoff to CRM after marketing shares signup slice.

zoe.marketing: Can you run one small mixed demo (50% header, 50% organic) at concurrency=3 so we can show routing in the live demo?

pat.eng: Scheduling mixed run (200 requests, concurrency=3). benchbot: started bench-1825000000-mix ETA 00:15:00.

pat.eng: Mixed run complete. Verified header propagation and no sampling loss at concurrency=3. Updated bench_map.csv with mixed run entries. Artifacts -> s3://redwood-dev/launch/1825000000/mixed/

sam.sales: Heads up sales: when you see X-RWI-Route:webinar-may + signup source=form, route to webinar queue. Prioritize leads that respond < 2 minutes.

zoe.marketing: Please paste final S3 paths and a one-line summary for each model (warmed p50/p95/cost estimate) so I can add to the slide.

pat.eng: Links above. Summary lines: 13B-4bit (warmed) p50=46ms p95=230ms cost~$0.11/1k tokens; 70B-fp16 (warmed) p50=125ms p95=460ms cost~$0.50/1k tokens. All runs include bench_run_id and X-RWI-Route where requested.

zoe.marketing: Perfect, thanks all. Tagging folks for slide review. If any issues surface in the next 24h ping here. :sparkles:
